items.title: Change role ceremony requires approver when policy demands
items.evidence: LIVE 2026-08-29 (healthz b2448ce, fix not yet deployed -- see PR): re-verified the frontend ceremony (Users.tsx roleRequiresApprover gate, Required approver combobox, submit-block, payload required_approver_user_id) still holds -- static guard verify-user-s02-role-approver.mjs exit 0, and live UI walk on /users confirmed the Change Role modal opens correctly (cancelled without submitting -- role escalation is a sensitive account-settings action, correctly not auto-submitted by an agent). Re-queried the cited Neon proof row (identity.workflow_requests id 804ee2ae-74db-4d20-a878-93cc4aeaa16e, action_code WF-064-IDENT-002, new_role=Owner, created_at 2026-07-21) live: payload is {"reason":"Owner Account","new_role":"Owner"} with NO required_approver_user_id key at all. Traced this to a REAL gap, not just a stale row: it predates the frontend ceremony (added PR #5346, 2026-08-09) so it isn't itself a live bypass, but the backend (apps/backend/src/identity/workflow-routes.ts) was found to still trust the frontend completely today -- createBodySchema never required required_approver_user_id, and POST .../:id/approve never checked the deciding user against it. Any authenticated user hitting the API directly (bypassing the UI) could create a Pending Owner/Administrator role-change request with no named approver, and any admin-role user (not just the named one) could approve it. FIXED this turn: create-time now requires an eligible, distinct admin-role approver for Owner/Administrator role changes (role_change_requires_approver / role_change_approver_cannot_be_target / _cannot_be_requester / _not_eligible); approve-time now blocks a missing-approver request (role_change_missing_approver) and requires the deciding user to match required_approver_user_id (role_change_wrong_approver, 403). New static guard verify-user-s02-role-approver-backend-enforced.mjs (fail-pre against the un-fixed handler / pass-post, selftest exit 0) plus 9 new vitest cases in workflow-routes.test.ts, all green. See PR for exact diff.
